description: This file is a shell script used to test the 'merge-recursive' functionality in a git environment. It defines various test cases to validate rename detection, thresholds, and merge behaviors related to filename changes during git merges.

methods.name: get_expected_stages
methods.description: Sets up expected git stages for a filename prefix, checking out a branch and listing files with stages to compare detected and undetected renames.

methods.name: rename_detected
methods.description: Checks that certain renames are detected by comparing actual git stages with expected stages.

methods.name: rename_undetected
methods.description: Verifies that certain renames remain undetected by comparing actual git stages with expected undetected stages.

methods.name: check_common
methods.description: Checks the total number of staged files in git to verify the expected number of changes.

methods.name: check_threshold_0
methods.description: Validates renames detection when similarity threshold is set to a low value, expecting more renames to be detected.

methods.name: check_threshold_1
methods.description: Validates renames detection at a medium similarity threshold.

methods.name: check_threshold_2
methods.description: Validates renames detection at a high similarity threshold.

methods.name: check_exact_renames
methods.description: Verifies that only exact (100%) renames are detected, with no undetected renames.

methods.name: check_no_renames
methods.description: Confirms that no rename detection occurs under certain configurations.
